Relation to My Work: Main baseline and diagnostic entry point

Title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
Limitation: Sparse final reward makes intermediate error attribution weak

Title: HiPRAG: Hierarchical Process Rewards for Efficient Agentic Retrieval Augmented Generation
Category: Process Reward and RL for Agentic RAG
Method Summary: Uses hierarchical knowledge-grounded process reward for search decisions
Limitation: Focuses search necessity more than state-conditioned evidence-chain contribution

Title: DecEx-RAG: Boosting Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Decision and Execution Optimization via Process Supervision
Category: Process Reward and RL for Agentic RAG
Key Contribution: Separates decision and execution optimization for Agentic RAG
Limitation: Explicitly addresses sparse reward and local step optimization
Code URL: Still needs comparison with state-aware evidence reward and stop repair

Title: R3-RAG: Learning Step-by-Step Reasoning and Retrieval for LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
Category: Process Reward and RL for Agentic RAG
Method Summary: Uses cold start plus RL to learn step-by-step reasoning and retrieval
Key Contribution: Combines outcome reward and relevance-based document verification
Limitation: Document process reward is mainly relevance-based rather than reasoning-state contribution
Relation to My Work: Useful comparison for RL-based retrieval reasoning

Title: InfoGain-RAG: Boosting Retrieval-Augmented Generation through Document Information Gain-based Reranking and Filtering
Method Summary: Defines document information gain via LLM confidence difference
Key Contribution: Trains a specialized reranker to filter useful documents
Limitation: Mostly static document utility rather than multi-hop state-aware utility

Title: Utility-Focused LLM Annotation for Retrieval and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
Method Summary: LLM annotates document utility for retrieval and RAG
Key Contribution: Improves out-of-domain retrieval and RAG performance
Limitation: Utility labels are not explicitly conditioned on Agentic RAG trajectory states

Title: REARANK: Reasoning Re-ranking Agent via Reinforcement Learning
Method Summary: LLM-based listwise reasoning reranker trained with RL
Key Contribution: Shows reasoning and RL can improve reranking with few annotations
Limitation: Not designed for multi-hop Agentic RAG trajectory repair
